item.text:
We’d love for you to join us for a little get-together to celebrate finally finishing the garden shed! It’s nothing fancy—just a chance to relax, enjoy some good company, and admire the results of all that measuring, hammering, and occasional head-scratching.

Drop by any time after four, whenever works best for you. We’ll have drinks and a few things to snack on, so come ready to make yourself comfortable and spend some time in the garden.

And please don’t feel you need to bring a gift. Your company is more than enough, and we’re simply happy to share the occasion with you. If you can only stay for a short while, we’d still love to see you!
